info.title: CF Meet Messaging API
info.description: HTTP surface of services/messaging: GET /health, /ready, /openapi.json (public, no data); the customer API under /v1/messaging and /v1/conversations (CF Meet API credential verified by Platform Access — afresh for every mutation; a verified acting principal; 503 when Platform Access is unreachable — fail closed; client tokens are refused with CLIENT_TOKENS_NOT_ENABLED). /internal/v1/** is service-authenticated and exposes no operation yet. Request bodies are limited to 512 KiB.

get.description: Readiness: database reachable and every migration applied (503 otherwise). No secret or connection detail.

post.description: Scope messages.send. A single-use challenge (server nonce, server-assigned device id) for the acting principal, bound to the credential and environment; rate-limited per principal. 503 FEATURE_DISABLED where E2EE device operations are not enabled.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The Platform Access principal the application backend acts for; honoured only inside the credential's principal restriction and when Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the credential's own environment.

post.description: Scope messages.send. Registers the device by its registration KeyPackage: RFC 9420 validation, the server-assigned credential identity and the signed challenge binding prove possession of the device key and freshness. Stores PUBLIC material only, appends a transparency leaf. Replaying the same answer returns the device (200).

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The Platform Access principal the application backend acts for; honoured only inside the credential's principal restriction and when Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the credential's own environment.

post.description: Scope messages.send. Publishes 1–20 KeyPackages of the acting principal's ACTIVE device: validated, bound to the device and its key, never last-resort or registration packages, unique by KeyPackageRef (re-submission is ALREADY_PUBLISHED), bounded per device.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The Platform Access principal the application backend acts for; honoured only inside the credential's principal restriction and when Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the credential's own environment.

post.description: Scope messages.send. Revokes the acting principal's device (terminal), closes its KeyPackages and appends a transparency leaf. Idempotent.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The Platform Access principal the application backend acts for; honoured only inside the credential's principal restriction and when Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the credential's own environment.

get.description: Scope messages.read. The ACTIVE devices (public keys) of an ACTIVE messaging principal of the credential's own environment; any other principal is NOT_FOUND. Rate-limited per credential. The tree head is signed with the log's Ed25519 key (Part V G.5); without a configured signing key the route answers 503, never an unsigned head.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The Platform Access principal the application backend acts for; honoured only inside the credential's principal restriction and when Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the credential's own environment.

get.description: Scope messages.read. Inclusion proofs (RFC 9162) of a device's log entries against the current tree head and, with fromTreeSize, a consistency proof. The log is UNWITNESSED: verifiable, not anti-equivocation. The tree head is signed with the log's Ed25519 key (Part V G.5); without a configured signing key the route answers 503, never an unsigned head.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The Platform Access principal the application backend acts for; honoured only inside the credential's principal restriction and when Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the credential's own environment.

post.description: Scope conversations.create; the acting principal becomes the owner. Context class and security profile are checked against the persisted effective policy: the profile defaults to the context's default (PRIVATE_E2EE where eligible), MANAGED only where the application policy allows it, never a silent fallback (E2EE_NOT_AVAILABLE when encryption cannot be established). DIRECT conversations are deduplicated per principal pair and profile; a live context reference is unique. Idempotency-Key replays the stored response (200).

201.description: Created (201) or an existing / replayed conversation (200).

get.description: Keyset-paginated, newest first (limit 1-100, cursor). With CF-Acting-Principal: that principal's conversations (messages.read); without: the environment's conversations (conversations.manage).

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal's own conversations (scope messages.read; for PATCH: the owner). Without it: the application's administration view (scope conversations.manage).

get.description: One conversation of the credential's environment; for a member principal (messages.read) or the administration (conversations.manage). Others: NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal's own conversations (scope messages.read; for PATCH: the owner). Without it: the application's administration view (scope conversations.manage).

patch.description: Scope conversations.manage. Server-authoritative lifecycle transitions (ACTIVE, LOCKED, CLOSED, ARCHIVED, DELETED; EXPIRED by the server only) and expiry, with optimistic concurrency (expectedVersion). Expiry is evaluated first. A security profile change is refused (SECURITY_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE).

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal's own conversations (scope messages.read; for PATCH: the owner). Without it: the application's administration view (scope conversations.manage).

get.description: Scope conversations.manage. The environment's overrides, their version and the effective policy.

put.description: Scope conversations.manage. Replaces the overrides (validated; optimistic concurrency on expectedVersion: POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT). Audited; existing conversations keep their snapshot.

get.description: ACTIVE members. With an acting member (messages.read) or the administration (conversations.manage); a non-member is NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal acts (member checks apply). Without it: the application's administration (scope conversations.manage).

post.description: Scope conversations.manage (+ OWNER / ADMIN when a principal acts). The principal must be ACTIVE and messaging-capable in the same environment; re-admission opens a NEW history window (no server-granted history, AD-07). DIRECT membership is fixed.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal acts (member checks apply). Without it: the application's administration (scope conversations.manage).

200.description: Idempotent replay of an earlier identical request.

delete.description: Leaving (acting = the member): messages.send. Removing another member: conversations.manage (+ OWNER / ADMIN). PRIVATE_E2EE: the member's devices become pending MLS removals; the group accepts only a removal commit until one is accepted (mlsRekeyRequired).

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: Optional. With it: the principal acts (member checks apply). Without it: the application's administration (scope conversations.manage).

get.description: Scope messages.read, acting member. Canonical order by sequence, within the member's history window; tombstones carry no content.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: The verified acting principal (Platform Access resolves it ACTIVE in the credential's environment).

post.description: Scope messages.send, acting member. Commits the message with the next canonical sequence and its durable event in one transaction (no realtime publish before commit). PRIVATE_E2EE: the PUBLIC MLS framing must name this group, an application message and the group's current epoch (EPOCH_MISMATCH otherwise; MLS_REKEY_REQUIRED while removals are pending). Retries with the same clientMessageId and bytes replay (200).

patch.description: MANAGED only (PRIVATE_E2EE edits are new ciphertexts with kind EDIT). Scope messages.send; the sender, within the policy's edit window.

delete.description: Scope messages.send. scope=EVERYONE (default, sender only): a server tombstone for every member, purged after the retention grace unless a legal hold protects it. scope=ME: hidden on the acting principal's own devices.
